summary.text: Tian Xia Xin is a Northern Plains wisdom path Gu Immortal who inherited Old Immortal Tian Yuan's true inheritance and farms at Myriad Bean Garden.

claims.text: He looks like an old farmer with a hunched back, fifty to sixty years old, with wrinkles on his face. His rough hands grab two special beanstalks. His pants are rolled up as he stands on mud. He has no demeanor of an immortal and looks like an ordinary old man.

Chu Du comes to Myriad Bean Garden while the outside world is in a mess and finds thousands of square kilometers of farmland with orderly irrigation channels. Most of the figures farming are inkmen with dark skin and white hair. Chu Du calls him the number one wisdom path Gu Immortal in Northern Plains and an unfettered expert. After hearing that, he raises his head and straightens his back. Facing the Domination Immortal, he has no fear or unease, and smiles lightly. He answers that there are hidden experts, that he could not learn much and had a weak foundation, and that he lost to Dong Fang Chang Fan by miles.

He was originally a mortal, not even a Gu Master. Under a coincidence he obtained an immense opportunity from an immortal, then became a wisdom path Gu Immortal secretly. He has ordinary aptitude, an ordinary immortal aperture, and calamities and tribulations that are not powerful. He has no grand ambitions. Dong Fang Chang Fan’s expansion interrupted his peaceful cultivation at home. After losing to that overbearing Dong Fang Chang Fan, he left Myriad Bean Garden and roamed, and the Northern Plains Gu Immortal world slowly learned of him. After Dong Fang Chang Fan died and Dong Fang tribe collapsed, he returned as owner of Myriad Bean Garden. Many Northern Plains Gu Immortals had promoted him as the number one person under Dong Fang Chang Fan. After that death he is publicly recognized as the number one wisdom path Gu Immortal in the Northern Plains Gu Immortal world. He still farms daily. He raises inkman slaves and is quite famous in that world for this.

Chu Du asks him to deduce a person and hands over flying sword Immortal Gu, a rank seven sword path Immortal Gu that looks like a silver winged dragonfly with wings flickering with silver light. He feels a cold chill looking at it, then names it and says Bo Qing once used it. Chu Du wants that deduction to find Fang Yuan’s location. He continues and says the Immortal Gu still belongs to the target, so he has a fifty percent chance. If the target is hiding inside an immortal aperture, he definitely cannot deduce anything. He needs three days at another location.

After the three days, in Myriad Bean Garden he sighs with some embarrassment on his face. He tried his best, but the other party is hiding inside an immortal aperture, and there are no results. He then says he has made some other gain. He returns flying sword Immortal Gu and points out an insignia left on it, which he has already deciphered as the key to an immortal’s true inheritance.

He rejects Chu Du’s guess that it is Sword Immortal Bo Qing’s sword path true inheritance. The insignia is an information path method, and according to his deduction it is an information path true inheritance whose location is not in Northern Plains but Eastern Sea. He warns Chu Du not to look down on it: the insignia was carved onto flying sword Immortal Gu after the Gu already existed, an information path method he calls unheard of and not ordinary.

He asks to negotiate. Chu Du interrupts and refuses, saying the Immortal Gu belongs to a missing friend, so the opportunity belongs to that friend as well. That Eastern Sea information path true inheritance is a different prize from the wisdom path legacy he already holds, and its quality is enough to interest him. He feels dejected, returns the Immortal Gu, and by his rules offers to take only half of Chu Du’s hefty payment because the deduction did not succeed. He looks at the Immortal Gu longingly. Chu Du refuses the half offer, says the work was worth the price, and leaves. He hesitates, but Chu Du is already gone. If it were others, he might have gone ahead to snatch it, but he does not have the courage to scheme against the Domination Immortal.

Liu Chang, after Liu tribe’s Gu formation fails to deduce Liu Guan Yi, says he will go and find Tian Xia Xin for help. In Myriad Bean Garden he returns half of the payment to Liu Chang. He smiles bitterly and says wisdom path deductions are not all-powerful, that he has tried his best, and that he is deeply sorry. Liu Chang leaves in disbelief. If the current number one wisdom path Gu Immortal in Northern Plains could not deduce Liu Guan Yi’s location, Liu Chang does not know who could.
Yin Wu Que, facing Hei Lou Lan, thinks his method has only failed against Tian Xia Xin and Zhou Ye Zi. He classifies Tian Xia Xin as a wisdom path Gu Immortal capable of deductions.
